description: A high-anonymous firm — most sales are cash/anonymous, identification share is low, and customer-section figures must be caveated as identified-only.

at_risk.definition: customers with 2+ lifetime visits whose last visit is 45-180 days before period end

good:
## Summary
High Anon Mart saw steady footfall. Revenue was SGD 10,000.00 this month, though only 25% of it is tied to identified customers.

## What went well
- 3 of 5 identified customers this month had already bought before, a returning-customer share of 60.0%.
- Wong K. carried 40.0% of identified revenue, or SGD 1,000.00.

## What needs attention
- Only 25% of revenue came from identified customers; the customer figures below describe them only, not all shoppers.
- 1 regular has not been seen in a while. One returned visit is worth SGD 50.00.

## Your customers
Wong K. carried 10.0% of all revenue, including anonymous sales.

## Do these three things next
1. Send one win-back message to the 1 at-risk regular this week. SGD 50.00 / 1 customer = SGD 50.00 each.
2. Ask identified customers for contact details at checkout to raise the 25% identification rate.
3. Review the 3 returning customers for a loyalty invite next month.
